summary: Every Magic request asks the operator not to offer the 24/7 subscription, and track flags any operator message that pitches one.
reason: Magic operators answer API requests from accounts without a 24/7 plan with a $199 subscription pitch. Declining got the errand done, so the CLI declines up front and keeps an agent from accepting a paid plan by accident.
validated_outcome: Live: a website-lookup errand drew the subscription pitch, and after a plain 'no subscription' reply the operator completed it within 15 minutes.
